headline: Movistar Peru Reports 19% Increase in EBITDA Through September
summary: Movistar reported that its EBITDA increased 19% year-over-year from January to September 2026, with operating results rising by S/52 million.
why: Movistar is a major telecommunications provider in Peru, and its financial performance reflects sector health and consumer demand for telecom services.

impacts.name: Movistar Peru
impacts.why: Higher EBITDA and operating results indicate improved profitability.
